observed_npm_audit.interpretation: all three package entries trace to the two image-size denial-of-service advisories below; npm audit is intentionally nonzero

advisories.impact: availability denial of service through malformed ICNS input
availability denial of service through malformed JXL or HEIF input

mitigations: reject ICNS, JXL, HEIF, HEIC and AVIF by extension before Automizer runs
reject affected signatures even when the media extension is disguised
fail before output PPTX or receipt creation
keep synthetic malicious-media regression tests in npm run verify
reopen_immediately_if: a compatible patched upstream release becomes available
a new advisory expands impact beyond the denied media families
the adapter is exposed as a network service or accepts uncontrolled public uploads
